license: Repository MIT license; no separate data license statement found in repository README.
preprocessing_in_source: Author README explicitly states no preprocessing has been performed.
label_basis: Author metadata mixing volumes and README nominal 1 M stocks, diluted to 375 uL total; concentrations in mM.
label_uncertainty: Nominal preparation labels; no independent chemical assay uncertainty is supplied.
recommended_split: Keep every spectrum from the same physical well together, across rounds, repeats and acquisition conditions.
limitations: This is conventional Raman, not SERS. Exclude modality=Raman for SERS-only experiments.
High/low integration-time spectra share the same wells. Low integration-time data were measured 24 h after preparation; acquisition time and sample age are confounded.
Stock concentrations are author-declared nominal values. No correction from weighed masses or solution density is applied.
Reducing sugars exist as solution equilibria; provided molecular SMILES are reference parent structures, not measured anomer populations.
spectral_processing_by_importer: None. Row sorting only; no interpolation, normalization, baseline correction or smoothing.
intensity_unit: Original arbitrary instrument units; not harmonized across instruments.

modality_details.classification_basis: Author experimental README describes conventional Raman measurement of sugar solutions without a SERS substrate.
modality_details.signal_species_relationship: Intrinsic Raman signatures of the analytical targets; reference SMILES do not establish adsorbed-state structures.
modality_details.assignment_scope: Imported measurement branch, including its associated blank controls.
